scope: 44 supplied English cards for the last 44 existing notes, plus one supplied regenerated SAMV-DUSt3R replacement. All current detailed bodies are preserved; all old card/figure blobs except the explicitly approved replacement remain unchanged.
review_method: Opened all 44 supplied images at original resolution in 22 two-card inspection sheets, plus the full regenerated SAMV-DUSt3R PNG. Read original-paper methods, result attribution and limitations; selected numeric-token locations supplement manual attribution and are not semantic proof.

papers.method_review: MapAnything metric geometry and learned scale feed a detection transformer with 2D proposals and direct up-to-scale box decoding. A causal five-frame window predicts current-frame class-agnostic oriented boxes; optional camera inputs and heuristic tracking are separate.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 1,3-6: CA-1M held-out AP25 16.9, AP50 3.5; zero-shot ScanNet200 frame AP15 15.2/AP25 9.7. ScanNetV2 scene tracking AP15 27.6/AP25 22.7. Five-frame inference 8.3 FPS; do not mix 50k ablation AP15 21.2 with the 100k main experiment.
papers.qualifications_review: Indoor training, no semantic classes. Learned scale is not guaranteed out of domain. Tracking replaces with larger visible boxes and is not probabilistic fusion. AP15 denotes an overlap threshold, not 15% error.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen DINOv2 and LoRA-adapted VGGT exchange image and object-query tokens. Camera/depth/semantic heads plus query masks form a segmented scene. Training-only FADA aligns frame attention and contributes Hungarian matching cost.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 full ScanNetv2/ScanNet200 class-aware mAP 50.4/31.9; Table 2 ten-scene class-agnostic zero-shot ScanNet++ mAP 13.3, AP50 33.9, AP25 56.4. Appendix runtime includes 9.25 s network plus 6.65 s postprocessing at 100 frames.
papers.qualifications_review: Absolute scale unavailable, indoor closed-set categories, global-attention memory and geometry noise. Benchmark predictions are transferred through official GT point-cloud superpoints by majority voting; this privileged evaluation mapping is disclosed in the card.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Masks, RGB, estimated/provided cameras and point maps plus category/caption condition TRELLIS.2 structure, geometry and appearance flows. Depth anchors translation/isotropic scale; rendered fitting places objects. Optional agent edits the generated mesh.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 1,3,7: four-view Toys4K CD .009/F1 .757/PSNR 17.60; ScanNet++ ADD-SB recall 95.63%. RealHANDAL agent improves PSNR 19.42 to 20.07 while CD .008 to .009 and F1 .936 to .923 worsen. Appendix simulation is not real-world physics verification.
papers.qualifications_review: Annotation-assisted masks/targets, sensor depth on LM-O/HB, estimated geometry on HANDAL/ScanNet++. Geometry/appearance alignment differs from joint placement metrics. Generative hidden surfaces and proprietary agent may be incorrect; up to ten minutes agent time and export excluded.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen StreamVGGT tokens feed a DPT/UNet branch with cross-property attention and shared decoder for friction, hardness, modulus and density. A separate pooled-token MLP predicts mass. Offline multi-view VLM/SAM2 material pseudo-labels supervise training; single-image inference needs no VLM.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 1-2: ABO-500 hundred-object test mass ADE 4.73 kg; real NeRF2Physics 13 scenes friction ADE .102 and hardness ADE 7.05. Image2mass zero-shot ALDE .585/MnRE .653 is worse than in-domain multi-view .437/.693. MnRE is higher better.
papers.qualifications_review: Visual estimates do not establish physical measurements or manipulation safety. No measured modulus/density benchmark; sparse physical measurements are not dense pixel validation. Friction depends on material pair and Shore A/D are not interchangeable.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Benchmark instance masks and unposed RGB yield point maps. GUIDE aligns reconstructed surfaces to canonical object shape and guides pose flow, ROUTE selects a reliable view, RECONCILE jointly optimizes object Sim(3) and cameras with fixed generated object Gaussians.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 four-view synthetic ARSG scene/object CD .055/.093, IoU .662; MIDI .069/.016, IoU .684. Appendix five-object H100 scene takes 326.5 s versus baseline 195 s; eight-view MIDI object CD .026 is worse than four-view .016.
papers.qualifications_review: GT camera-center scene Sim3 alignment, no per-object alignment; placement error remains in both CD metrics. Masks are provided, hidden geometry is generated, evaluation is synthetic and does not establish real-world collision correctness or metric scale.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: MASt3R co-visibility/pair point maps and synchronized metric robot kinematics/odometry enter joint iterative optimization of scene, cameras, hand-eye transforms and scale. Planar mobile motion needs separate floor-based camera-height estimation.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables I-II: 25-pose Franka Object hand-eye translation .415 cm/rotation .011 rad; GraspNet 1.744 cm/.023 rad. Franka checkerboard scale error 3.67% versus VGGT+Calib 5.67%; this pattern is evaluation-only.
papers.qualifications_review: Metric robot motion is an input, so inference is not RGB-only scale recovery. Static scenes, accurate synchronized poses, diverse motions, co-visibility and mobile floor segmentation required. No end-to-end runtime established.

papers.method_review: Natural-language constraint tracking, VGGT/CleanDIFT geometry, GroundingDINO/SAM2/BLIP2 semantics and a world-aligned BEV/FMM planner run under LangGraph state/recovery orchestration. Known camera height anchors initial scale.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 fixed 550-episode simulated R2R-CE unseen subset: SR 21.3%, SPL 12.1%, OSR 29.5%, NE 7.85 m. Appendix fixed-scale AbsRel .5874 versus per-frame GT median-aligned .0493 is a post-hoc diagnostic, not deployed accuracy.
papers.qualifications_review: Initial panoramic scan excluded from action budget; single-run subset. CA-Nav sensor inputs and NavGPT discrete graph differ. Runtime entries are per-module calls, not end-to-end FPS. Real-robot efficacy and safety unverified; RGB only still assumes known height.

papers.method_review: VoT (collection alias FVO) uses frozen CroCo patch features and trainable camera tokens with temporal-then-spatial transformer attention. Pose heads predict relative translation and SVD-projected rotation; composition yields trajectory.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 1-4 unaligned ATE: ARKitScenes .51 m, ScanNet .34 m, KITTI 63.10 m, TUM RGBD .47 m. Rotation is not uniformly strongest. Two-view ScanNet attention ablation differs from main eight-frame setup.
papers.qualifications_review: No intrinsics input, depth, map, loop closure, bundle adjustment or test-time optimization. Metric translation is learned from pose supervision, not monocular scale observability. Static training and nonstandard KITTI 70/30 split limit claims; reported 3x runtime lacks FPS.

papers.method_review: Registered metric RGB-D and fixed intrinsics condition Pow3R at token, pair-scale and backend-depth anchor sites. Descriptor-free projective matching and Sim3 optimization track poses; retrieval closes loops. Optional sensor-ICP hybrid is separate.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Section IV and Tables II-III: 24-scene all-frame SE3-aligned ATE .037 versus .116 m, with no scale fitting. Sim3-aligned 15-scene map Chamfer 3.05 versus 4.35 cm. Subsample-two loop FPS 18.6, hybrid 25.3, excluding loading.
papers.qualifications_review: Depth is sensor input, completed holes are inferred. Lower ETH3D completion count 14 versus 16 and lower AUC; stairs ATE worsens. Repetition, depth noise and calibration matter. Three-percent conditioning ablation still uses full sensor depth for scale/anchors.

papers.method_review: JCR uses pretrained DUSt3R image-pair reconstruction, known metric end-effector motions and scale-aware hand-eye solving, then filters/alines points and learns continuous occupancy/color/segmentation MLPs.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Three tabletop scenes on a real Unitree Z1. Nine of nine settings converge versus four of nine for COLMAP with same calibration. Figure 4 ten-image height errors: tape 2.5%, box 2.9%, mug 3.1%, toolbox .7%. Representation fitting within fifteen seconds excludes reconstruction/calibration.
papers.qualifications_review: Needs accurate metric kinematics and diverse motion. Small static tabletop study; some object heights worsen with more images. Unknown occupancy is not certified free space; no quantitative collision or grasp evaluation.

papers.method_review: CARVE adds fixed inverse-depth weights and geometry/depth/camera consistency losses to VGGT. Two frame-wise cross-attention blocks inject high-resolution frozen DINOv2 features into low-resolution global tokens; heads output depth, shared points and cameras.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 3-7: aligned reconstruction C-L1 KITTI .238 m and ETH3D .236 m (worse than VGGT .202). TUM depth Rel .040. At 32 frames on H200, high-resolution model 15.26 FPS/16.05 GiB versus high-resolution VGGT 2.54 FPS/47.89 GiB.
papers.qualifications_review: Scale-aligned evaluations do not establish learned metric scale. Loss/data findings are context-specific; high-resolution speedup is relative to high-resolution baseline and still below low-resolution VGGT. No streaming or robot-control evidence.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen pi3 aggregation/point-map pathway supplies features. Fourteen per-frame pooled camera queries use local bidirectional temporal stages then global integration to regress SE3 poses. FFVO-Long adds chunked post-optimization.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 1-3: WOD nine scenes ATE .862 m versus frozen pi3 1.150; no-augmentation .714 is lower. PDD1 1314 test segments ATE 2.494 m. Post-optimized KITTI eleven-sequence mean ATE 12.960 m.
papers.qualifications_review: Sim3-aligned ATE and adjacent-frame RPE can hide scale/drift. Proprietary data, bidirectional windows, no measured end-to-end FPS/memory comparison, degraded-weather/light failures and separate long-sequence optimization qualify claims.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen VGGT is studied through fundamental-matrix probes, cross-view attention matching and attention-head interventions on controlled Blender/ShapeNet image pairs. Occlusions and symmetry test learned priors.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3-6 and appendices: matching emerges in layers 10-16 before F decodability around 12-14. Midlayer head knockouts damage geometry; occlusion retains inferred matches. The card gives no invented benchmark ranking.
papers.qualifications_review: Synthetic textureless scenes confound SIFT comparison. Probe decodability is not proof of algorithm. Interventions can remove other functions, and hallucinated hidden correspondences may be wrong. No universal real-world robustness claim.

papers.method_review: Sparse retrieved/Doppelganger-filtered view graph selects local pi3 star reconstructions and deep tracks. Robust rotation/similarity averaging connects stars; real SIFT, deep and virtual reprojected tracks constrain augmented bundle adjustment.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 1,4,6,9-10: unknown-calibration ETH3D AUC@1 53.0 versus SIFT 45.6. Minimal SMERF ablation AUC@20 rises 68.3 to 82.1 with virtual tracks. LaMAR median motion averaging 177.5 s and augmented BA 19505.91 s, not real time.
papers.qualifications_review: No metric-scale guarantee. Virtual tracks encode learned priors rather than observations. Graph filtering may exclude images; multiple networks and BA expensive. Fisheye and severe appearance/transient-object cases limited; not uniformly strongest on all datasets.

papers.method_review: Known intrinsics, textured metric CAD model and CNOS image mask are required. Forty rendered RGB/CAD-coordinate templates match MASt3R features; CAD maps lift 2D correspondences for EPnP-RANSAC. Optional pretrained MegaPose refines top hypotheses.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Published CVPR paper Table 1: seven-dataset BOP coarse mean AR 39.5 at 1.4 s/image, refined 57.3 at 8.0 s; GigaPose refined 57.9. Supplement confirms A100, 320-square templates, 400 RANSAC iterations/10-pixel inliers. Illustrative ranking scores are explicitly not measurements.
papers.qualifications_review: Training-free refers to coarse target-task pipeline, not pretrained encoder or optional trained refinement. Known model/mask/calibration remain required; heavy occlusion and reference-frame alignment impair matching. No SLAM output.

papers.method_review: Source-supervised VGGT is adapted to unlabeled in-vivo video via detached teacher depth transfer and sequence/pair/pixel reliability gates. Source losses and fixed scale anchors preserve geometry; gated EMA updates the teacher.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables I-II eight-frame windows: SimCol3D/C3VD AbsRel .1692/.0675 versus source-only .1436/.0608. In-vivo cross-view residual falls .0764 to .0479 but uniform EMA .0435 is still lower while worsening controlled depth.
papers.qualifications_review: No metric in-vivo GT and no explicit tissue deformation estimate. Cross-view residual is internal consistency, not absolute accuracy or clinical efficacy. Eight-frame quasi-rigid domain and differing baseline camera parameterization limit comparison.

papers.method_review: Unposed views, visual subject mask and relation text feed frozen DINOv2/pi3 geometry-semantic fusion, a subject-conditioned relation transformer and BERT text-feature segmentation.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 three-benchmark macro mIoU .382 versus RelationField .303. RelationField also receives target categories, known poses and scene-specific optimization; different interfaces are disclosed.
papers.qualifications_review: Training uses instance-labeled scenes and automated annotations. Dense clutter is difficult and functional relations are not modeled. A subject mask remains an input; no universal scene understanding or metric reconstruction guarantee.

papers.method_review: PSFM compresses unposed context views into spatial latent tokens and predicts novel-view geometry/semantic features using camera queries and frozen VGGT/DINOv3 targets. Frozen Spa3R augments Qwen2.5-VL through residual cross-attention; asymmetric aggregation prevents leakage.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables V-VI matched VSI-Bench instruction tuning: Spa3-VLM mean 58.6% versus direct VGGT features 55.1% and no spatial branch 50.9%. This aggregate mixes numerical MRA and multiple-choice accuracy.
papers.qualifications_review: Static indoor data; inherits frozen geometry priors and pose estimates. Feature prediction is not complete measured unseen geometry, uncertainty is not calibrated, and latent disentanglement is unproven.

papers.method_review: A supervised ViT encoder/decoder regresses layered camera-aligned 3D intersections from one image. A separate ViT predicts each ray stopping index so only ordered valid layers are retained.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 3 SCRREAM real indoor unseen-surface F-score@.05 is .494 versus CUT3R five iterations .238. Evaluation uses scale-shift alignment and ground-truth validity masks; this is not raw metric accuracy.
papers.qualifications_review: Deterministic hidden surfaces are inferred and can be wrong. Sparse sampling on ray-parallel surfaces and synthetic-to-real domain gap remain. Visible and overall metrics are not uniformly strongest.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen VGGT/WorldMirror source representations condition a relative-pose diffusion transformer. Generated target-view features are decoded by a frozen DPT depth head. Requested target poses are inputs.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 3 one-source to one-target DTU affine-aligned AbsRel .012 versus VGGT-DD .022. Larger unseen regions are generated, not observed geometry.
papers.qualifications_review: Low source-target overlap loses detail and consistency; reference camera affects results. Zero-shot means held-out scene/domain generalization of an offline-trained diffusion model, not an untrained model.

papers.method_review: Per-agent frozen MASt3R tracking/point-map fusion feeds cross-agent retrieval and bidirectional verification. Shared Sim3 graph aligns gauges; terminal alternating pose and segment-depth refinement runs after capture.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Section IV four split-stream Tanks and Temples scenes: mean F-score at .10 m 76.1% versus concatenated MASt3R baseline 73.1%. Not uniformly best across scenes or driving sequences.
papers.qualifications_review: Needs shared static structure and reliable cross-agent matches. Centralized coordination, offline terminal refinement and missing complete scaling/latency evaluation limit deployment claims. Learned scale and separately aligned trajectories do not guarantee metric accuracy.

papers.method_review: SAM masks form graph vertices. Learned 3D reconstruction and pixel correspondences add cross-view matching edges; contraction merges masks. Geometric subsumption edges and further contraction resolve oversegmented fragments into object identities.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table I GraspNet-1B main best-overlap IoU .5945 versus 2D-only GraphSeg-minus .3916, shown as 59.45% and 39.16%. These are segmentation scores, not grasp success rates.
papers.qualifications_review: Tabletop-focused evaluation; mask and geometry errors propagate. Real-robot grasp demonstrations do not establish quantified grasp success or reliable general scene segmentation.

papers.method_review: Monocular RGB plus IMU supports pointmap Sim3 constraints translated into metric SE3 pose-and-scale states in sliding-window optimization. A distinct global graph uses logged constraints, loop closures and optional GNSS.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Section VI KITTI-360 visual-inertial mean relative translation error is 17.7% lower than DBA-Fusion. This is a relative error reduction, not a success percentage or a universal ranking.
papers.qualifications_review: Experiments primarily assume known camera/sensor calibration. IMU supplies metric observability; GNSS is optional for global refinement. Pointmap shape errors and far-to-near projections require weighting; online and global results are distinct.

papers.method_review: Multi-camera RGB and optional camera IDs/time/rig metadata condition a multiview transformer. Pointmaps plus global and rig-relative raymaps yield cameras and clustered rig structure; metadata dropout handles missing metadata.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 1,3 unseen WayveScenes101 pose mAA up to 30 degrees is 65.2% with full rig metadata versus 25.7% without. Intrinsics are withheld in this evaluation; this is not a metric scale guarantee.
papers.qualifications_review: Generalization depends on rig diversity/data quality; dynamic content remains challenging. Camera readout assumes a centered principal point. Optional rig inputs and inferred outputs must not be confused.

papers.method_review: A fast two-view frontend tracks consecutive keyframes, a multiview backend forms submaps and depth-based relative scales, and a unified Sim3 graph jointly refines view/submap nodes with loop constraints.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 uncalibrated RGB 7-Scenes Sim3-aligned ATE RMSE .020 m versus VGGT-SLAM .037 m. Supplement compares alternative frontend latency.
papers.qualifications_review: Iterative optimization remains part of this feed-forward-model SLAM system. Scale alignment does not establish raw metric accuracy. VGGT frontend latency exceeds specialized pairwise alternatives; inaccurate scale estimates degrade results.

papers.method_review: Decode loss-implied uncertainty from confidence and audit ranking, level, slope and coverage against reference geometry on seven frozen backbones/thirteen datasets. Fit a rank-preserving two-constant power law on labeled calibration scenes.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Main text and Table 2: target-dataset-held-out correction reduces median uncertainty calibration mismatch from about 2.4x to 1.35x. Ideal factor is one; these are not geometry accuracy gains.
papers.qualifications_review: Dataset-level correction does not ensure scene-level coverage: about two thirds of held-out scenes remain outside a five-point band. VGGT loss constant is unverified and limits absolute audit. Reference/labeled data is used for audit/calibration.

papers.method_review: A multiview transformer and dense head generate input-dependent image perturbations. A geometry-targeted objective with perceptual/magnitude regularization trains the generator; test generation is feed-forward.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 CO3D eight-view shifted Chamfer between clean and perturbed VGGT outputs: MVAP-G 2.011 versus twenty-step AP 1.958. Higher values mean greater output disruption, not improved reconstruction.
papers.qualifications_review: Digital VGGT-focused evidence; physical and cross-model transfer are not established. Small changes do not prove imperceptibility. Defense development remains future work.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Absolute-coordinate sparse 3D convolution encodes unordered partial point-cloud scans. Alternating within/cross-scan attention initialized from pi3 predicts global rigid poses directly; optional SE3 diffusion refines the joint pose set.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 ScanNet 32 sequences/thirty scans: mean translation error .15 m versus sparse-graph MDGD .37 m. Optional diffusion median improves but rotation mean 7.1 degrees worsens from 6.7.
papers.qualifications_review: Input is 3D scans, not RGB; no depth inference is needed. Indoor rigid registration scope; diffusion adds iterative inference and does not improve every metric.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: A scene-trained dual Swin network predicts world ray directions and unit-distance world points. Differentiable Kabsch/SVD recovers camera rotation and translation. 3DGS synthetic views and domain-adversarial training support learning; rendering refinement is optional.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 Cambridge four-scene mean of median errors, excluding Court: base GRLoc 37 cm/.68 degrees versus RAP 56 cm/1.28 degrees. These are base results, not rendering-refined scores.
papers.qualifications_review: Requires scene-specific training and scene imagery/poses for learning. Optional 3DGS refinement depends on render fidelity and adds cost. This is absolute scene localization, not arbitrary-scene zero-shot mapping.

papers.method_review: A DUSt3R-initialized symmetric image-pair network regresses relative rotation and translation direction. A motion-averaging module uses retrieved posed references to aggregate rotations and intersect camera-center rays for absolute pose.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 4 Reloc3r-512 on 7-Scenes: mean of scene median errors .04 m/1.02 degrees. Generalization is from broad eight-million-pair training without target-scene retraining.
papers.qualifications_review: Posed reference database and retrieval required. Pair translation has unknown magnitude; collinear camera centers cause scale ambiguity. Intrinsics variation and reference quality affect performance.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Uncalibrated endoscopic video uses short/long memory and transformer point-map/confidence decoding. Estimated intrinsics and PnP yield pose; flow/geometry filtering and confidence pruning manage dynamic memory. Supervised and pseudo-depth/flow objectives train the model.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 unseen Hamlyn depth AbsRel .170 versus MonST3R .198. Source separately reports surgical benchmark pose/depth performance; card does not invent clinical or robot success evidence.
papers.qualifications_review: Temporal scale consistency does not establish calibrated absolute metric scale. Learned dynamic filtering has failure modes and benchmark evidence is not clinical validation.

papers.method_review: Visible-target and occluder masks condition pretrained DINOv2/TRELLIS sparse-structure and structured-latent flows. Visibility-weighted image cross-attention followed by occluder-mask attention generates stochastic full objects; frozen decoders yield mesh/Gaussians/radiance field.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 1-2 single-view synthetic rendered occlusion: GSO FID/P-FID 30.64/7.69, Toys4K 23.45/5.00 versus pix2gestalt+TRELLIS 58.82/26.43 and 43.05/26.04. These are distribution metrics, not object accuracy or success.
papers.qualifications_review: Synthetic furniture-heavy 20627 assets, qualitative real-world evidence, ambiguous hidden surfaces, no environmental context or user control. Full model is not strongest in every ablation metric.

papers.method_review: Foreground-masked RGB-D plus known intrinsics and query rays feed point self-attention and point-to-ray cross-attention fused with frozen DINOv2. Heads predict novel depth/confidence/masks; query/fuse twenty-two views including a regenerated input view.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 YCB-Video CD 3.56 mm/F1@10mm .930, HOPE 3.92/.926, synthetic OctMAE 5.21/.893. LaRI/Unique3D/TRELLIS receive GT similarity/ICP alignment while RaySt3R does not.
papers.qualifications_review: Not RGB-only: input depth, mask and calibration required. Hidden geometry is inferred; false-negative masks and synthetic-training limits propagate. F1 is geometric matching, not grasp success; confidence trades accuracy against completeness.

papers.method_review: Classical calibrated SLAM supplies unchanged poses. Asynchronous DA3 dense mapping rectifies images and optimizes only per-frame and per-submap scales, then fuses depth-consistent points and refreshes scale after loops.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table III real ScaRF R03 chunk-wise precision 81.26%, mean error .0198 m and recall 55.38%. Ten-meter chunks use Sim3 then ICP, three-cm threshold/two-cm voxel. This experiment is visual-inertial, not RGB only.
papers.qualifications_review: Scale correction cannot fix arbitrary shape error or improve tracking poses. Ablations use GT poses; whole-map 2.9-cm result differs in protocol. Mapping batch ~1.5 s is asynchronous and not tracking FPS; qualitative robot demo has no task success.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Semantic dynamic masks and GeoCalib initialize keyframe graph BA combining DROID flow, sparse cuVSLAM tracks and metric-depth priors. Joint pose/intrinsics/keyframe-depth solving, non-keyframe pose infilling and video-depth alignment support diverse camera models.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 1-3: TUM Freiburg1 ATE 3.6 cm, KITTI cropped first1024-frame ATE 9.2 m, ETH3D depth RelAbs .16. RTX5090 runtime excludes per-frame dense depth when possible; reported 3-5 FPS is not thirty-FPS online SLAM.
papers.qualifications_review: Near-metric learned depth prior, fixed centered principal point and dynamic semantic masks can fail. Shuttle/Sampson are consistency proxies. Large dataset release contains predicted labels, not sensor GT.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Problem-driven survey maps feature enhancement, geometry awareness, efficiency, augmentation and temporal modeling. It distinguishes points/Gaussians/implicit fields and direct, recurrent, gradient-refined, fine-tuned and fast-weight/memory inference regimes.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 2-7 and figures/tables organize existing work and practical evaluation. Card supplies no invented experimental ranking; appearance and geometry evidence are distinct and compute comparisons require matched budgets.
papers.qualifications_review: Survey is not a new reconstruction algorithm. Single-pass and gradient-free behavior are not guaranteed for all methods. Benchmark bias, limited reliable GT, scalability, generative plausibility versus fidelity, and physical/action consistency remain open.

papers.method_review: Underwater-adapted MASt3R estimates matches/point maps and tracks Sim3 poses. Medium-reduced structural comparison inserts Gaussians; voxel-local attention decodes residual parameters and a learned attenuation/backscatter model supports joint optimization/rendering.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables II-IV: UW-Stereo-VI PSNR36.31 dB/ATE .157 m improves WaterSplat-SLAM27.06/.350; RedSea ATE .958 is worse than .882. SeaThru PSNR24.83 is below UW-GS25.79. Training throughput .51-1.08 FPS is not rendering FPS.
papers.qualifications_review: Not a purely feed-forward or video-rate method. Learned medium/scene model, dynamic organisms/particles and domain shifts limit generalization. Internet pseudo-GT and held-out rendering protocol disclosed; source insertion-threshold inconsistency explicitly identified on card.

papers.method_review: Pretrained high-frequency DROID recurrence creates graph topology and targets; lower-frequency DINO/Flow3r proposes targets only on existing edges. Consistency-gated replacement locks accepted targets, avoids double counting and feeds one shared dense BA over pose/depth/optional intrinsics.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables1-3,6-8: Sim3-aligned Replica ATE .002 m versus VGGT-SLAM2 .030. TUM .027 versus SLAMFormer .039; 7-Scenes .051 worsens against .041. A100 processing 7.399 FPS. Basic-tracking .0027 to .0023 ablation prevents crediting all gains to Flow3r.
papers.qualifications_review: No loop closure, so long outdoor sequences drift. Feed-forward reliability, short context, texture/dynamics/viewpoint/scale failure modes remain. No navigation task success is established.

papers.method_review: RGB room transitions partition visits; MapAnything reconstructs each room and boundary pairs give Sim3 edges. Verified revisit merging and room-only LM optimization produce a hierarchical graph. RecognizeAnything/GroundingDINO/SAM2 tracklets lift object points with room poses.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table III real Aria office average ATE .305 m versus ViSTA .982; GT is camera VIO, not surveyed external truth. Table VIII full 1.56 FPS versus12.92 without objects; segmentation87.9% runtime. Semantic TableV uses GT depth/poses, not full RGB-only pipeline.
papers.qualifications_review: Deferred room reconstruction adds latency, open plans segment poorly, room detector errors propagate, and object poses only follow parent rooms. Not a navigation policy, not universally best semantic scores. DINO/text alignment underspecified.

papers.method_review: Dark3R-distilled MASt3R-SLAM pair geometry/confidence/descriptors feed reciprocal matching gates and relative Sim3 optimization. Split tracking/mapping resolution and device-side solve improvements reduce backend cost. Lost tracking can explicitly emit no pose.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table I Jetson chapel minus10-dB synthetic noise on real stills:3.204poses/s, ATE20.70% of no-information ceiling,10.95GiB. This is not20.70% success. TableIII nine-rung stills and every-frame device protocol are distinct.
papers.qualifications_review: Four of44 classifiable every-frame runs silently fail, including deploy config. Continuous-video baselines lead and real zero-frame Spot sequence has no pose GT. Narrow coverage, absorbing tracking loss, three-scene/single-sensor scope preclude general safe-navigation claims.

papers.method_review: Frozen Pi3X yields local geometry and approximate scale. A trained warp/confidence matching branch builds overlapping-window sparse tracks; rotation/position averaging and bundle adjustment jointly refine cameras/points/intrinsics. Dense depths are calibrated and fused after BA.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables1,3-5: fourteen T&T scenes Nerfacto PSNR19.56dB versus COLMAP18.73 is a pose-quality proxy. KITTI aligned mean RMSE13.21m versus Scal3R14.55. ETH3D RRA/RTA@1 degree91.58/73.27%. 800-frame speed2.06FPS.
papers.qualifications_review: Global optimization is separate from feed-forward backbone. Dense points are not all BA variables, learned scale approximate. Repetition and initial fragmentation remain; some windows increased from20 to120/200frames. Not best every sequence or thirty-FPS online.

papers.method_review: Known georeferenced RGB map/planar poses and odometry support pose-clustered place beliefs. Hybrid particles select a small set of references; DA3 geometry is robustly Sim2-aligned to known map poses and fused with appearance likelihoods.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table2 COLD/4Seasons/RobotCar mean position error .124/.268/.494m versus .215/1.404/1.687. 4Seasons AUC .864 worsens from .897. Table3 DA3-Large .237s excludes rest of pipeline/loading.
papers.qualifications_review: Known map, odometry and planar motion required. Storage includes references but excludes checkpoints; ALLOM uses less storage. Three seeds/three query runs, initial frame excluded, no statistical significance or end-to-end real-time claim. Fixed fusion ignores geometry confidence.

papers.method_review: Two Google Earth Studio scenes test ten-image orbital spans30-360degrees for VGGT/Pi3X/VGGT-Omega. A separate70-view VGGT-Omega pseudo-reference and one global Sim3/trimmed-ICP alignment preserve duplicate geometry in evaluation.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables1-2 full-orbit F-scores: VGGT-Omega86.05/94.74%, VGGT23.69/9.44%, Pi3X14.87/15.26%. Scores are agreement with a model-derived reference, not independent physical accuracy.
papers.qualifications_review: Reference-model bias, only two rendered scenes and confounded overlap/rotation/content. Mechanism explanations are hypotheses, not isolated ablations. No new reconstruction algorithm or universal robustness claim.

papers.method_review: An eight-slot VGGT window has anchor, retained context and latest candidate. After every frame has already run VGGT, an RL actor retains/discards it from future context; all-frame poses are preserved. PPO trains in TartanAir with a privileged critic.
papers.reported_evidence_review: TableIV matched strategy aligned ATE: learned KITTI87.0m/TUM.186m/EuRoC2.44m. TableV total380.2ms per frame versus policy .74ms; VGGT aggregator370ms dominates. VGGT-Long TUM .169 is lower under a different configuration.
papers.qualifications_review: No inference skipping for discarded frames, no loop closure/global BA or long-term memory. Short context and modified comparison windows limit generality; simulator training and real benchmark tests are not robot success evidence.
